The '''250 Hover-Cam''', also known as the '''DLI-250''', was a model of [[Cam droid/Legends|hovercam]] manufactured by [[Data-Link Industries]]. It had a 50 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] flight ceiling and could be controlled by a [[Beckon call/Legends|beckon call]].<ref name="KRR" />
